resolved_logo_asset.what_it_is: A*STAR corporate logo (blue 'a' mark with red star + wordmark 'Agency for Science, Technology and Research / SINGAPORE')
resolved_logo_asset.verified: Downloaded directly from www.a-star.edu.sg. 20365 bytes, PNG, 530x200. Opened and visually inspected: it is a real corporate logo lockup, not a photo, screenshot, favicon or badge.
resolved_logo_asset.canonical_proof: The identical media GUID is served as the site header logo on the A*STAR corporate homepage (alt="HQ") and on the A*STAR Graduate Academy scholarship site (alt="Scholarships"), so it is A*STAR's own corporate mark rather than a page-specific graphic.
resolved_logo_asset.scope_caveat: None of these five A*STAR awards publishes a standalone programme logo. The A*STAR corporate logo is the official brand mark of the awarding body, which is the official_source named on every record in this shard.

validation.notes: WEAKEST LINK IN THIS SHARD - read before using. The record's own official_source_url is dead (HTTP 404) and SINGA's dedicated microsite is offline, so the logo could NOT be taken from the scholarship's own official page the way records 101/437/438/530 were. The asset used is A*STAR's official corporate logo, published on the A*STAR corporate homepage. Identity is nonetheless established from an official A*STAR page, not from a third party: www.a-star.edu.sg/bii/join-us/graduate-research states verbatim 'The Singapore International Graduate Award (SINGA) is a collaboration between the Agency for Science, Technology & Research (A*STAR), the Nanyang Technological University (NTU), the National University of Singapore (NUS) and the Singapore University of Technology and Design (SUTD).' www.a-star.edu.sg/ime/careers also lists SINGA among A*STAR graduate awards for international students. No SINGA-specific programme logo exists on the official domain. SINGA is also absent from the live A*STAR Graduate Academy scholarship listing (0 occurrences of 'SINGA'), so this award appears to be in a transitional state on A*STAR's site. If the catalogue requires a programme-specific mark rather than the awarding body's mark, set this to not_found.
